Zara (People Ops): Heads-up: mid-cycle peer-eval sampling change — we're shifting to stratified sampling this cycle to reduce reviewer load and make samples more representative. Read below and sign up for training if needed.
Evan (Manager): Can you tl;dr the change?
Zara (People Ops): TL;DR: instead of sampling the same 10% across all teams, we'll sample by role band + tenure bucket. That means smaller samples for small teams and focused sampling on hybrid roles. Objective: faster calibrations, fewer ambiguous cases.
Hannah (Manager): How will this affect my managers who normally submit 20%?
Zara (People Ops): If your team is usually oversampled, we'll ask a lightweight justification form (1 bullet) to keep extra samples. Otherwise follow the auto-sampler.
Luis (Eng): Is the sampler configurable per org? I have a split infra/app team.
Zara (People Ops): We've added a "split-team" flag in the tracker. Mark it and sampler treats them as two strata. Link: https://rwd.co/sampler-config
Evan (Manager): What about transparency? Will teams know who was sampled?
Zara (People Ops): Managers will see which roles were sampled in the tracker but not the random seed. We'll publish aggregate sampling rationale post-calibration.
FeedbackBot: Reminder: sampler training live session tomorrow 30m. Sign-up: https://rwd.co/sampler-training :calendar:
Hannah (Manager): Any impact to embargo or timeline?
Zara (People Ops): No embargo change. Form cutoff remains 2026-04-08 23:59 UTC; calibration windows unchanged. This is only a sampling change.
Luis (Eng): If the sampler picks someone who is a conversion candidate, do we route them differently?
Zara (People Ops): Yes: conversion candidates get an automatic "conversion review" flag so Recruiting and Finance join micro-calib. Mark conversions on the form too.
Evan (Manager): How should I explain this to my team?
Zara (People Ops): Suggested line: "We're trying to reduce reviewer fatigue and make samples fairer; you may or may not be sampled this cycle but all development feedback continues as normal."
Hannah (Manager): If a manager disagrees with the sample selection, is there an appeals flow?
Zara (People Ops): Submit a short appeal in the tracker within 24h of sampling publish and include a 1-sentence reason. People Ops will respond in <48h.
Luis (Eng): Any change to the reviewer handoff if someone is OOO?
Zara (People Ops): Same SLA: reassign 72h before the session. For sampled people, paste the last 2 feedback snippets + a 1-line context note in the backfill column.
Evan (Manager): Are we keeping the calibration note template?
Zara (People Ops): Yes. Tiny reminder to use this snippet in review comments: `Cal note: evidence | rubric level | recommended outcome`. Keep it to 1-3 bullets.
FeedbackBot: Auto-post: sampler pub scheduled 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC. Check tracker for your team. :bell:
Hannah (Manager): Recording policy for sampler training?
Zara (People Ops): Recordings allowed for internal use, delete after 30 days. Add a short TLP note in the training doc.
Luis (Eng): Thanks for signing up for training.
Evan (Manager): Thanks Zara. Will brief my managers.
Zara (People Ops): Thanks all — if you hit any edge cases DM @people-ops and we'll triage.
